name: Kamiyama Ryuu
source:
A young man who has trouble fitting in with the people around him and tends to be withdrawn.
He's smart, skilled at everything, and not bad looking if he dresses well, but his personality is a drawback.
With the encouragement of his younger sister, he somehow manages to get a job at a game company.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071013020509/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/ls/char.htm]official site, archived[/url]]
